text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about pedestrian safety on their roadway. Our office has received a petition from residents with support for the installation of all-way stop controls at the above mentioned intersection. I am requesting that all-way stop controls be installed at Leuty Avenue and Alfresco Lawn.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Leuty Avenue and Alfresco Lawn.
